hero.headline: I build useful software that makes work feel lighter.
hero.intro: PHP and Laravel developer with experience supporting ERP users and building business software. I care about clear systems, practical interfaces and code that holds up in real use.

about.lead: I turn complex business processes into software people can actually use.
body: My foundation is in Management Information Systems, with hands-on experience in a graduate PHP development programme at Data Design. I started close to users, learning how incidents and requests affect day-to-day work, then moved into feature development for the Tiramisu ERP.
Since then I have worked across the stack: PHP and PostgreSQL on the backend, JavaScript and modern UI tooling on the frontend, with testing, reviews and documentation as part of the process.
I am especially interested in finance and operations systems, e-commerce, developer tooling and practical AI workflows that keep people in control.

principles.title: Clarity first
principles.text: Model the workflow before adding abstraction. Make the important state visible.

principles.title: Build for trust
principles.text: Validate input, respect permissions and make consequential actions auditable.

principles.title: Keep improving
principles.text: Use tests, feedback and measurable performance work to make each iteration stronger.
